item.title: Union Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to introduce Appropriation Bill 2026 in Lok Sabha during Budget Session
item.description: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman will introduce the Appropriation Bill 2026 in the Lok Sabha during the ongoing Parliament Budget Session. The House will also discuss and vote on Supplementary Demands for Grants for the financial year 2025-26.

item.title: Election Commission likely to announce poll dates for 5 states on 15 or 16 March; Details here
item.description: The Election Commission of India is expected to announce the schedule for legislative assembly elections in five states - Tamil Nadu, Kerala, West Bengal, and Assam - and the union territory of Puducherry on March 15 or 16. Preparations are in the final stage after consultations with political parties and officials.

item.title: Stock Market Today: Sensex tumbles, Nifty trades below 23,450 amid heavy selling
item.description: Indian stock markets opened sharply lower on Friday, with the Sensex falling over 650 points and the Nifty slipping below the 23,450 mark in early trade. Heavy selling in major stocks like L&#38;T and HDFC Bank dragged the indices down.

item.title: Gold, Silver rebound on MCX despite strong Dollar; Check prices in your city
item.description: Gold and silver prices showed a mild recovery in early trade on March 13 despite a stronger US dollar and fading hopes of a Federal Reserve rate cut. On MCX, gold futures rose 0.06% to around ₹1,60,368 per 10 grams, while silver gained 0.25% to ₹2,68,637 per kilogram.

item.title: Highway travel to get costlier in Tamil Nadu as toll rates increase from 1 April; Details here
item.description: Toll charges at 28 plazas across Tamil Nadu will increase from April 1 as part of the annual revision on National Highways. Light vehicles like cars and vans may see a hike of ₹10–₹40, while buses and trucks could pay ₹50-₹200 more.

item.title: Sunrisers Leeds X account suspended after signing Pakistan’s Abrar Ahmed in The Hundred auction
item.description: Sunrisers Leeds’ official X account has been suspended following the team’s decision to buy Pakistan spinner Abrar Ahmed in The Hundred 2026 auction. Owned by Sun TV’s Kavya Maran, the move sparked massive outrage in India, with fans demanding a boycott of Sunrisers Hyderabad in the upcoming IPL.

item.title: Tamil Nadu: CM MK Stalin to convene DMK District Secretaries meeting in Chennai; Details here
item.description: DMK President and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin will chair a meeting of district secretaries on March 15, at 10:30 AM in Arivalayam, Chennai.

item.title: J&K: Police head constable, wife killed after car falls into river in Doda
item.description: A police head constable and his wife were killed while their two children were injured after their car met with an accident in the Bhaderwah area of Doda district, Jammu and Kashmir. The Alto car reportedly lost control near Basti village and plunged into a river.

item.title: ‘Nobody Will Hire Women’: Supreme Court turns down plea on mandating menstrual leaves
item.description: The Supreme Court declined a plea seeking mandatory menstrual leave for women, saying such a law could discourage employers from hiring them. The court stressed awareness and voluntary measures instead of legal compulsion.

item.title: ‘Public Is Angry, You Can’t Come To Power’: Kiren Rijiju slams opposition MPs over Lok Sabha disruptions
item.description: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju criticised Opposition MPs for disrupting Lok Sabha proceedings, warning that continued disruptions could anger the public and damage their chances of returning to power in future elections.
